discovery.eyebrow: ● A SECRET HIDDEN IN THE TEXT
discovery.title: There are songs inside the Scriptures. Almost no one knows.
discovery.body: Not songs about the Scriptures. Songs <1>in</1> them — surfaced from the Paleo-Hebrew itself, read symbol by symbol, sung from the perspective of the ones who were already singing when the foundations went down. We have been quietly working on this for a long time. It is not theory. The songs exist.
